name: Touch of Weakness
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: You be far from home, Champion. You be needed there, back in your city under the ground. Your mistress, the one you be callin' Aelthalyste be needin' you back there. Like my tribe, there things you must learn only from her. Don't be stayin' here too long. You should be headin' to the War Quarter as fast as a zeppelin can carry you.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, young champion, I am glad you have returned here. I would teach you a lesson you would do well to not forget. Are you prepared?
